svg.title: Figure 20.3 · Expert loads
svg.desc: For each of the 19 MoE layers, 24 dots show each expert's share of routing slots. Most layers cluster between 2.4% and 6.6% around the even 4.2%; layers 2 and 3 spread from 0.7% to 9.5%.
svg.text: How each MoE layer spreads its tokens over 24 experts
share of routing slots per expert · 64 held-out windows of 512 tokens · measured
